We need to determine appropriate charges.

Facts: Company exec and others fraudulently induced contracts, collected deposits, guarantee money, etc. This is contract fraud (合同诈骗). Also possibly illegal occupation of farmland (非法占用农用地) because they occupied farmer land without compensation. The description: "以开发...为名...占用农民耕地没有补偿，不具备任何施工条件". That is illegal occupation of farmland. Also they used false documents (伪造银行存取款凭条) maybe "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章". But the bank documents are private, not state. Could be "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" only for state documents. Not applicable.

The main crime: contract fraud. Also possibly "诈骗" generic? In training, they differentiate contract fraud vs fraud. The examples: earlier case with contract fraud used label "合同诈骗". So we should use that.

Also "非法占用农用地" is a specific charge. In list: "非法占用农用地". Yes.

Thus answer: 合同诈骗;非法占用农用地

Check if any other charges: "受贿"? No. "行贿"? No. "单位行贿"? No. "单位受贿"? No. "诈骗" generic maybe but contract fraud is more specific.

Thus final answer.
